confidence_notes: Two web searches were run: one for the RBA rate and one for Mombasa prices. The price search returned crowd-sourced cost-of-living figures (mylifeelsewhere, traveltables) that disagree with each other and vary in date. Meal, beer and coffee anchors are moderately supported by them. The search gave no cocktail or wine figures, so I set cocktail and wine from a typical beer-to-cocktail/wine relationship, with imported wine priced high. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for or inspect any listings. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 observation shown on the RBA overview page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Mombasa crowd-sourced price indexes, with Nairobi and other Kenyan coastal tourist areas as a rough comparison. Prices are mid-range for East Africa, with tourist-area restaurants costing more than local eateries.
